title: Aoyagi Toya — A Brief Nap〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito reignited Mita and everyone in Vivid Street...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That day, we lost so much. However...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're still able to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I guess I shouldn't expect any less from Akito...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No matter how tough things get...
He has the force of will to get through it all.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And I'm singing now because of him.
Come to think of it, he...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested.
Hey, how would you like to try singing together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Why is he showing so much interest in me...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't even know how long I'm going to be singing here for.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is my first time singing in an event. The makeup of the audience is so different from that of a piano concert...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They're cheering so loudly. All this energy.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And Akito's voice is becoming a part of this electric atmosphere. He's singing better than he usually does when we practice.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Yes, there are others who are better at staying in rhythm and maintaining their pitch...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The way he's singing. What I'm seeing as I stand next to him. I feel so much passion emanating from him.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now, if I can match that with my singing...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No... We can still do better.
Next time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I promise to do what I can do put on a better performance next time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I may be no different from everyone in Vivid Street.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Just like with them, the energy he gave off ignited a fire in me that propelled me to where I am now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Originally, I was looking for any other genre of music besides classical.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the reason I've been able to stick to this for so long is because Akito was there beside me the whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I'm now deeply immersed in street music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I need to not let Akito's efforts go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to fan the fire he started and make it even bigger. That's my job.
